senses.gloss:
(इर) भिदिर् r. 7th cl. (भिनत्ति-भिंत्ते)
To break, to break or tear to pieces.

mfn. (-भिद् or भित्)
Who or what breaks, divides, severs, destroys, &c.
f. (-भिट् or भित्)
1 Kind, sort, difference.
2 Breaking, dividing.
E.
भिद to break, and aff. क्विप्.

m. (-कः)
A sword.
n. (-कं)
INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
भिद to break, aff. क्वुन्.

f. (-दा)
1 Tearing, rending.
2 Coriander.
E.
भिद to divide, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

m. (-दिः)
INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
भिद to break, Uṇādi aff इ, and the vowel unchanged; also भिट्.

n. (-रं)
INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
भिद to break or split, किरच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-दुः)
The thunderbolt. of INDRA.
E.
भिद to split, Uṇādi aff. कु.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Brittle.
n. (-रं)
The thunderbolt.
E.
भिद to break, (the earth, the mountains, &c.) कुरच् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
To be, or what may be broken.
E.
भिद to break, केलिमर् aff.

m. (-द्यः)
A river, a male river.
E.
भिद to break, (its banks,) क्यप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being divided, pierced, broken, &c.
2 Being separated or distinguished.
E.
भिद to break, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mn. (-द्रः-द्रं)
The thunderbolt.
E.
भिद to break, Uṇādi aff. रक्; also भिदु, भिदुर, &c.
